status: ANALYTICAL SCREEN; NOT EXPERIMENTAL TRUTH OR CFD ACCEPTANCE TARGET
geometry_idealization: Straight, fully developed semicircular duct; corrugation, entry development, headers and collectors omitted.

relations.pressure_drop: dP = f_D*(L/Dh)*(rho*U^2/2); laminar semicircle relation converted from Fanning to Darcy basis
relations.duty_screen: Two fully-developed Nusselt asymptotes feed an idealized counterflow epsilon-NTU screen.

limitations: The duty range is a two-correlation screening band, not a statistical uncertainty interval.
The duct idealization does not represent the corrugated reconstructed geometry.
No pointwise experiment match was established.
Not used as a post-hoc acceptance target.

correlation_references.title: Hydrodynamically Developing and Fully Developed Laminar Flows in a Semicircular Duct: Analytical and Computational Analyses
